entry.description: Model source entry point: the platform bundles an executable form from this module and calls [export](values) → IModel with the knob values of the active config version. The bundled form (dist/index.mjs) is produced by the platform and is not shipped in the bundle. Invalid values raise a typed ConfigValidationError.

rtp.description: Share of the bet returned to the player on average. The win multiplier is rtp / winChance, so this knob sets the house edge directly.

target_min.description: Lowest target the player can pick, in roll units (0..9999). Caps the maximum multiplier for condition = under.

target_max.description: Highest target the player can pick, in roll units (0..9999). Caps the maximum multiplier for condition = over.

default_target.description: Target preselected when the game opens. Must lie within [target_min, target_max].

target.description: Comparison threshold in roll units. Bounds come from the target_min / target_max knobs of the active config and are deliberately not repeated here as numbers, so there is a single source of truth. The client reads the effective bounds from initData.targetMin / initData.targetMax. A target outside them rejects the round.

condition.description: Bet direction: over wins when roll > target, under wins when roll < target.

bet.description: Bet in minor currency units (denomination is set by the RGS, not by the model). The floor is 1 — the smallest positive integer amount: a zero or negative bet is not a round and is rejected. The ceiling is the largest exactly representable integer in a double (Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER); above it an integer win is no longer guaranteed. Both are technical limits, not product bet limits — product bet limits are declared by the RGS and are not part of the model contract yet.

rtp.description: Value of the rtp knob. The client uses it to preview the multiplier.

roll.description: Roll outcome, uniform over [0, 9999]. Exactly one RNG draw per round.

target.description: Threshold from the request, echoed unchanged.

condition.description: Direction from the request, echoed unchanged.

multiplier.description: rtp / winChance. Always returned, including on a losing round.

win.description: Payout in minor currency units: round(bet * multiplier) on a win, 0 on a loss. Mirrors PlayResult.win.

roll.description: Roll re-derived from the recorded RNG buffer. Must match playData.roll of the same round.
